messages:
Avery (PM): heads up — planning sync: we need to settle API vs Console prioritization for the next quarter. multiple customer asks and a few sales pushes. i want to frame the tradeoffs and decide sequencing.
Sam (Eng): +1. can we use a simple framework? RICE or impact/effort matrix?
Priya (DevEx): RICE helps with objective scoring. but for developer friction vs platform completeness we should weight 'time-to-adopt' higher. customers care about quick API prototyping.
Marco (Design): design implication: full console work is months (auth flows, RBAC, table UIs). smaller consoles (quickstarts, example flows) are much cheaper.
Olivia (Sales): we have 3 pilots that asked for console admin UI to manage model pinning and rollout rules. without console some deals stall.
Avery (PM): proposal: Phase 1 = ship opinionated API endpoints + templated quickstarts in Console (no full CRUD). Phase 2 = admin Console for rollouts + metrics. Phase 3 = feature parity. thoughts?
Sam (Eng): sequence seems reasonable. engineering caveat: API-first + SDKs is fastest, ~6w for core endpoints. basic Console quickstarts could be a small React app we scaffold.
Riley (SRE): need to include canary and fallback controls in Phase 1 API surface so customers can implement safe rollouts. otherwise platform risk.
Priya (DevEx): we should commit to docs + 3 sample apps in phase 1. that reduces friction more than a big Console. Also include sample curl + JS snippets.
Avery (PM): let's try RICE scoring quickly: Reach = number of customers impacted (high for API, medium for console), Impact = conversion to paid (medium-high for console), Confidence = how sure we are about estimates (higher for API), Effort = eng-weeks. any volunteers to plug numbers?
Marco (Design): roughs: API R: 8, I: 6, C: 7, E: 4 (lower is better effort). Console R: 5, I: 7, C: 5, E: 12.
Sam (Eng): dev estimate: API core endpoints (generate, embeddings, model-mgmt) = 8 eng-weeks. SDK + quickstarts = 4. Console quickstarts (minimal UI) = 3. Console admin = 10+
Olivia (Sales): can we ship a 'console-lite' admin mock to show to pilots? even a gated internal UI would help contracts.
Avery (PM): proposal adjusted: 1) API + SDKs + docs + 3 sample apps (6 weeks), 2) gated console-lite demo for pilots (2 weeks), 3) public admin console iteration (10 weeks).
Riley (SRE): schedule note: any admin console needs RBAC and audit logs before GA if customers are enterprise. factor extra time for security review.
Sam (Eng): define launch criteria per phase: Phase 1 GA = endpoints stable under 100qps and passing regression test-suite + 3 sample apps. Phase 2 private demo = internal feature flag + pilot enablement + audit logging for pilot tenants.
Priya (DevEx): add evals: quality regression alerting on prompt sets must be in Phase 1 for any rollout to avoid bad outputs breaking pilots.
Marco (Design): UX compromise: instead of full model config panels initially, show a single 'pin/rollback' control and a timeline view. much less effort.
Olivia (Sales): That would unblock 2 deals this quarter if we can show pin/rollback in demo.
Avery (PM): tradeoff discussion: API-first = lower dev friction for engineers, faster adoption; Console-first = better story for non-engineering buyers, helps sales. Suggested weighting: prioritize API but release console-lite in parallel to unblock pilots.
Sam (Eng): parallel work requires more headcount. if we can't add people, do API then console-lite.
Riley (SRE): ops note: implement feature-flag gate + per-tenant capacity limits so pilot consoles can't overload infra.
Priya (DevEx): also recommend shipping a CLI tool to cover some Console use-cases for non-UI power users — cheaper than a full admin UI.
Avery (PM): decision intent: commit to API-first (Phase 1) + SDKs + docs + sample apps, and a gated console-lite demo for pilots (Phase 2). add CLI prototype as stretch. we'll re-evaluate after pilots.
Sam (Eng): can we make a checklist for launch criteria? I'll draft in the ticket (#PR-452).
Avery (PM): yes please. checklist should include RICE assumptions, perf targets, safety checks, docs, SDKs, sample apps, pilot enablement steps.
Olivia (Sales): i'll line up pilot customers and get acceptance criteria from them.
Marco (Design): i'll produce the console-lite mock and the pin/rollback comp in Figma by EOD Friday.
Riley (SRE): i'll start on RBAC/audit skeleton and rate-limit config.
deploy-bot: Scheduled a brief deploy to staging for API v0.9 tomorrow 02:00 UTC — watch for smoke test results.
Avery (PM): thank you. follow-ups: Sam to add estimates to #PR-452, Priya to define sample apps, Olivia to collect pilot acceptance, Marco to hand off mocks. we'll sync next Tues. :handshake:
Sam (Eng): ack
Priya (DevEx): ack :rocket:
